name: Shieldshooter
author: Marcus Ramse
description: A simple platform shooter: shoot the other players and raise your shield to block their shots. There is no win condition. X to shoot, Z to shield.

descriptions.en: A simple platform shooter: shoot the other players and raise your shield to block their shots. There is no win condition. X to shoot, Z to shield.
descriptions.it: Un semplice sparatutto a piattaforme: spara agli altri giocatori e alza lo scudo per bloccare i loro colpi. Non c'è un modo per vincere. X spara, Z scudo.
